svg.title: launches
svg.text: Where the 7.49× comes from: launches per decode step
naive: a Python loop over 16 layers × 32 sequences, ~15–20 tiny GPU ops each; fused: 16 launches, one per layer
naive path: ≈ 9,000 small launches + 512 host→GPU copies (step ≈ 58 ms)
one layer, zoomed: 32 sequences, each a burst of ops:
fused path: 16 launches, each a grid of num_seqs × 32 programs (step ≈ 7.6 ms)
← same time scale as the bar above

g.text: fused step done; naive still running

svg.text: Bytes don't explain the gap: all weights ≈ 0.5 ms, all KV ≈ 0.03 ms per step at these context lengths.
Each tiny launch costs microseconds of CPU + driver time; thousands of them per step are the cost.
